english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person or animal that obeys instructions and does what it is told.

examples.english: This dog is very docile; when you tell it to sit, it sits right away.
examples.traditional: 呢隻狗好聽話嘅，叫佢坐低就即刻坐低。
